canonical_title: Emergency egress exits and routes - documentation
subject_group: 9.6.3 Emergency ground, ditching, and water egress

versions.title_at_revision: Emergency egress exits and routes - documentation
versions.text:
Standard: Technical manuals incorporate crewmember emergency egress procedures. Crewmembers are trained in emergency egress procedures. Passenger briefings are provided to crewmembers, and passenger emergency egress instructions are readily available to passengers. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine relevant documentation (e.g., technical manuals, training manuals, and training syllabus) and verify egress and rescue procedures for crewmembers, passengers, and ground rescue personnel.
